qualitative.note: Fails Gate 2 (Rejected – G2 Essential Need). Listing country Greece is classified outside core Western developed markets (in_market == 'N'); additionally, Jumbo's discount toys, seasonal items, and home knick-knacks represent non-essential discretionary retail.
qualitative.evidence: Jumbo operates ~85 discount hyperstores across Greece, Romania, Bulgaria, and Cyprus selling toys, seasonal merchandise, and home decor. While generating robust gross margins (~53%) and maintaining a net cash balance sheet, Greece carries in_market == 'N' pre-screen status, and merchandise demand is exposed to discretionary consumer spending cycles in Southeastern Europe.
